title: 댐 주변지역 친환경 보전 및 활용에 관한 특별법 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 기후에너지환경부 (수자원개발과), 044-201-7697
rows.text_en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment ( Water Resources Development Division ), 044-201-7697

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「댐 주변지역 친환경 보전 및 활용에 관한 특별법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Eco-friendly Conservation and Utilization of Areas Surrounding Dams and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(사업계획 승인 신청서) 「댐 주변지역 친환경 보전 및 활용에 관한 특별법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제4조제1항 또는 제6조 본문에 따라 댐 및 주변지역 친환경 활용 사업의 시행자(이하 “사업시행자”라 한다)가 댐 및 주변지역 친환경 활용 계획의 승인 또는 변경승인을 받으려는 경우에는 별지 제1호서식의 댐 및 주변지역 친환경 활용 계획 승인(변경승인) 신청서에 사업계획을 적은 서류를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2021. 2. 17., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Approval of Project Plan) In accordance with Article 4 , Paragraph 1 or the main text of Article 6 of the Special Act on the Eco-friendly Conservation and Utilization of Areas Surrounding Dams (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), if an implementer of an eco-friendly utilization project for dams and surrounding areas (hereinafter referred to as the “Project Implementer”) intends to obtain approval or approval for modification of a plan for the eco-friendly utilization of dams and surrounding areas, they shall submit an Application for Approval (Approval for Modification) of the Plan for the Eco-friendly Utilization of Dams and Surrounding Areas ( Form No. 1 ) to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, attaching documents containing the project plan. <Amended Feb. 17, 2021; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(실시계획 승인 신청서) 법 제9조제1항 또는 제11조 본문에 따라 사업시행자가 댐 및 주변지역 친환경 활용 사업 실시계획(이하 “실시계획”이라 한다)의 승인 또는 변경승인을 받으려는 경우에는 별지 제2호서식의 실시계획 승인(변경승인) 신청서에 실시계획을 적은 서류와 「댐 주변지역 친환경 보전 및 활용에 관한 특별법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제8조 각 호에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 관할 유역환경청장 또는 지방환경청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2021. 2. 17.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Approval of Implementation Plan) In cases where a project implementer intends to obtain approval or approval for modification of an implementation plan for the eco-friendly utilization of dams and surrounding areas (hereinafter referred to as the “Implementation Plan”) pursuant to Article 9(1) or the main text of Article 11 of the Act, the implementer shall submit an Application for Approval (Approval for Modification) of the Implementation Plan in the form of Annex 2 to the competent Basin Environmental Office or Regional Environmental Office, attaching documents containing the implementation plan and documents pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 8 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Eco-friendly Conservation and Utilization of Dam-Surrounding Areas (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”). <Amended Feb. 17, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(증표) 법 제13조제4항에 따른 증표는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Identification) The identification pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제5조(준공검사) ① 영 제12조제1항에 따른 준공검사 신청서는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Completion Inspection) ①The application for completion inspection pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제12조제2항 본문에 따른 준공검사 확인증은 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of completion inspection pursuant to the main text of Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(행정처분 기준) 법 제25조제2항에 따른 행정처분의 기준은 별표와 같다.

rows.text_en: This rule will take effect on June 13, 2019.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제6조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 부령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Ordinances.

rows.text_en: 16. The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Eco-friendly Conservation and Utilization of Areas Surrounding Dams are partially amended as follows.

rows.text_en: In Article 2, “Minister of Environment” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.text_en: In the back of Form No. 1 and Form No. 3, “Minister of Environment” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment” respectively.

rows.text_en: In the business processing procedure section of Form No. 1, “Ministry of Environment” shall be changed to “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”.
